For Sol-owned items, Luna can implement settled subtasks while Sol owns the coupled design and integration. Escalate new authority/crypto/role decisions or unresolved parser/scope invariants to Sol rather than guessing.
model_assignment.escalation_rule: Start with the assigned Luna or Sol author. Escalate Luna to Sol high when a specified contract cannot be implemented without redesign, evidence conflicts, an authority/lifecycle race remains unresolved, or two substantive fixes fail the same decisive check; provide a minimal reproduction, attempted fixes and current patch. Sol can resolve the difficult part and return bounded implementation to Luna. Astra is an exceptional last resort only if documented Sol attempts and review demonstrate a specific remaining capability need; never schedule or escalate to Astra solely because the item is security-sensitive or complex. Preserve evidence and continue independent work.
